definitions.explanation: The respiratory organ in the chest. Used in both everyday and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {肺|はい}で{呼吸|こきゅう}する。
{肺|はい}のレントゲンを{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I had an X-ray of my lungs taken.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{喫煙|きつえん}で{肺|はい}が{弱|よわ}っている。
examples.english: My lungs are weakened from years of smoking.

notes:
{肺|はい} is the organ responsible for breathing. Humans have two lungs ({左右|さゆう}の{肺|はい}).

COMMON MEDICAL COMPOUNDS:
- {肺炎|はいえん}: pneumonia
- {肺|はい}がん: lung cancer
- {肺活量|はいかつりょう}: lung capacity (vital capacity)
- {肺|はい}のレントゲン: lung X-ray
- {肺結核|はいけっかく}: pulmonary tuberculosis

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {肺|はい}が{弱|よわ}い: to have weak lungs
- {肺|はい}に{水|みず}がたまる: fluid in the lungs
- {肺|はい}を{強|きた}える: to strengthen the lungs

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {心臓|しんぞう}: heart
- {気管|きかん}: trachea, windpipe
- {気管支|きかんし}: bronchi
- {横隔膜|おうかくまく}: diaphragm
